correctness.rationale: For normalized cube Laplacian L=I-A/d, normalized Walsh characters of weight j have heat eigenvalue exp(-2tj/d). Restriction to a fixed codimension-c face aggregates 2^c inner Walsh indices by their Hamming weight r, leaving for each free index S a row-scaled m-by-(1+min(c,K-|S|)) Vandermonde matrix at distinct z_j. Thus every block has stated min rank; summing gives exact formula for all d>=1,c,K,m in stated ranges. For c>=2 two restricted degree-one eigencharacters cancel for all time. For c=1 and K=d, the precisely normalized 1/sqrt2 blocks [[1,1],[r^k,r^{k+1}]] give all squared singular values, determinant and unique D-optimal tau; derivative of log determinant changes sign only at r=(d-1)/(d+1). Independent fresh NumPy rank checks for d=2..5, all c,K and m=1,2,3, and block determinant computations at d=2..5 exactly matched predicted rank and determinant up to numeric tolerance; infinite proof is Walsh/Vandermonde.
